title: I MADE A GAME
author: Old-Bat-1442
selftext:
Hello folks 👋  
  
I recently made a cricket game called Batting Against All Odds with Jabali AI, and I'm looking for players to test it and give feedback.  
  
The game is all about surviving against more and more difficult bowling. Every ball counts and one mistake can break your run. The job is easy, score as many runs as you can and see how long you can last against the odds.  
  
This was made as a test to see how far AI can push game development and I’d love to hear what you real players think about it.  
  
Please try it and let me know:  
Your best score \* What you liked What needs to be improved on  
  
Thanks for checking it out and good luck at the crease! 🏏🔥LINK- [https://www.jabali.ai/game/3ecf5ac6-153e-4fd1-bd9f-6fdbbcc7ea6b/create-from-scratch/batting-against-all-odds](https://www.jabali.ai/game/3ecf5ac6-153e-4fd1-bd9f-6fdbbcc7ea6b/create-from-scratch/batting-against-all-odds) 

Thanks for your time, and if you decide to try it, let me know your highest score
